text: No business can improve unless it pays the closest possible attention to complaints and suggestions. If there is any defect in service then that must be instantly and rigorously investigated, but when the suggestion is only as to style, one has to make sure whether it is not merely a personal whim that is being voiced.
author: Henry Ford
reference: My Life and Work (with Samuel Crowther)
locator: Chapter IV, The Secret of Manufacturing and Serving
